problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & 2 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -5\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

feedback.problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -6 & 8 \\ -2 & -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 12 & 18\end{aligned}].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.
feedback.worked_solution:
Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -6 & 8 \\ -2 & -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 12 & 18\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -6 & 8 \\ 0 & -1 & -12 & 16 \\ 0 & 1 & 12 & 18\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -6 & 8 \\ 0 & -1 & -12 & 16 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 34\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The corresponding system is now

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-2y-6z=8 \\ 0x-y-12z=16 \\ 0x+0y+0z=34\end{aligned}
$$

Since there are no such numbers $x,y,z$ that form a solution of the final equation $0x+0y+0z=34,$ we can conclude that our system has no solution.
